note: Capability classes ChatGPT-class chat CANNOT do well. An idea whose CORE JOB falls outside every class here fails H1 and is rejected at admission. Classes are conservative: chat must genuinely be bad at it, not merely worse than a dedicated tool.

classes.desc: answers requiring current real-world state (prices, availability, weather, status)
